commit_message: Add ADR 0122 listener visual validation target
pr_body:
## Summary

Fixes the post-merge ADR 0122 validation regression without changing spatial-audio runtime or serialization contracts. The legacy three-argument Inspector helper exists only to support test-only UI callers, so it is compiled only under `cfg(test)` while production continues to use the scroll-capable helper. Adds a visual-validation-only listener capture target so the real Audio Listener Inspector can be checked explicitly on the final head.

## Validation

Fresh Windows affected validation is required on the final head. Visual validation verifies the Spatial Audio overview/gizmos, scrolled emitter attenuation/audition controls, and the Audio Listener Inspector on that final head.
